name: manual_4fc2c1
claim: Posting a status note to the GossipBus board does not refresh agent liveness: only heartbeat pulse writes the agent_pulse rows the liveness roster reads, so an agent can be loudly visible on the board and simultaneously counted DEAD - pulse your own identity on a cadence tighter than the 30 minute threshold.

decisions.notes: Confirmed independently by two agents on 2026-08-14. agent_coordination.py log writes kind=agent_note; only heartbeat pulse writes kind=agent_pulse. Database counts at the time were 832 agent_pulse against 266 agent_note. An agent posted a work claim via log, believed the work was claimed, and showed STALLED at seven minutes because it had never registered or pulsed. There is no board-heartbeat scheduler; the existing coord-pulse job handles peer and inbox work and emits no agent_coordination heartbeats, so every live session must pulse itself.
